theory.title: Repaso integrado: preguntas, modales, condicionales y comunicación
theory.explanation: Este punto de control repasa los contenidos de la Unidad 2 y no introduce gramática nueva. Elige las estructuras según el significado, el contexto, el grado de cortesía y la relación entre las personas que hablan.
theory.tip: Antes de elegir una estructura, piensa qué quieres expresar: pedir información, aconsejar, especular, imaginar una situación o contrastar ideas.

content.passage: A local group wanted to organise a welcome evening for new neighbours. First, they asked what activities people enjoyed and whether anyone needed help. Some members had different ideas; however, they listened carefully and found a compromise. They agreed that private information must not be shared without permission. If the weather were bad, they would use the community hall. One organiser wished more people could attend, but the final plan was flexible enough for everyone. Since the first meeting, the group has been keeping in touch and sharing updates.

items.prompt: Describe a relationship that is important to you.
items.modelAnswer: I believe strong relationships depend on respect, patience and regular communication. Although people sometimes disagree, they can usually find a solution if they listen carefully. I try to be clear and polite, and I make time to keep in touch with people who matter to me.
